headline: SAMSUNG **VS** LG:
TWO AI BETS

cover.image_prompt: Cinematic split composition at dusk: a futuristic kitchen with a glowing refrigerator scanning food on the left, an electric van beside a tiny modern cottage on the right, a glowing thread connecting them. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand names, no people.

slides.title: KES 2026, Korea's biggest electronics show
body: Samsung and LG opened side by side on **Oct 13**, with two very different ideas of where AI should live.

slides.title: AI in your hand
body: Built around the **Galaxy Z Fold8**. Its fridge camera recognizes ingredients, and its washer-dryer senses the load and picks the cycle itself.

slides.title: AI from home to car
body: LG's **ThinQ ON** AI hub links the house and the car: check on your home and control appliances while you drive.

slides.title: Robots and data centers
body: **LG MoMa** robots moved materials in a mock smart factory. A “chip to chiller” line targets **AI data center** cooling.

slides.title: Devices vs. spaces
body: Samsung connects **your devices**. LG connects **your spaces**, from home to car to factory.

facts.text: KES 2026 (Korea Electronics Show) opened on Oct 13, 2026 (Oct. 13). Samsung's booth was 869 sq m and LG's 902 sq m.

Samsung centered its zone on the Galaxy Z Fold8 series. The Bespoke AI Family Hub fridge's AI Food Manager camera recognizes ingredients; the Bespoke AI Combo washer-dryer senses laundry and sets modes automatically.
LG ThinQ ON AI home hub connects home and car: check the home and remotely control appliances from the car.
Three LG MoMa mobile manipulator robots demonstrated material transport and safety detection in a smart factory. LG's chip to chiller solution covers cold plates, CDUs and chillers for data centers.
Core contrast in the article: Samsung connects personal devices; LG connects living spaces (home and car) and extends into factories and data centers.

sources.title: [KES2026] From AI in your hand to factories: Samsung 'AI in everyday life', LG 'expanding to industry'

caption:
Same show, opposite AI strategies.

At KES 2026 in Seoul, Samsung put AI in your pocket and your kitchen. LG took it out of the house: into your car, onto factory floors and inside data centers.

→ Samsung: Galaxy Z Fold8, a fridge that recognizes ingredients, a washer that picks its own cycle
→ LG: ThinQ ON links home and car, LG MoMa factory robots, data center cooling

Which bet wins?
